en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a central photograph showing a panoramic coastal view of a town and fortress across a bay, with rocky shore in the foreground and a boat or small ferry on the water. Decorative Art‑Nouveau style borders frame the image. At the top center is a green Greek postage stamp. There is cursive handwriting on the right side. Under the image, a French caption reads "Vue panoramique de Corfou".
